defs.def: the energy from the sun, a lamp, etc. that makes it possible to see things 光；光线；光亮

ex.s: Rereading makes it possible for us to see the world around us, ourselves included, in a new light.
ex.t: 重读使我们能够以一种新的眼光看待我们周围的世界，包括我们自己。

ex.s: To understand a painting, we’re taught to look for color, composition, and light.
ex.t: 为了理解一幅画，我们被教导要去寻找色彩、构图和光线。

ex.s: The noise from the LRAD is directed like a ray of light and travels only into the ears of that person, but it is not deadly.
ex.t: LRAD发出的噪音像一束光线一样定向传播，只进入那个人的耳朵，但它不会致命。

ex.s: Kevin Balke, a research engineer at the Texas A&M University Transportation Institute, says that while smart lights can be particularly beneficial for some cities, others are so jammed that only a sharp reduction in the number of cars on the road will make a meaningful difference.
ex.t: 德克萨斯A&M大学交通研究所的研究工程师凯文·巴尔克(Kevin Balke)表示，虽然智能灯对一些城市特别有利，但另一些城市却卡住了，只有急剧减少路上的汽车数量才能产生有意义的变化。

ex.s: The part of your brain that controls your own movements lights up in response.
ex.t: 控制你自己运动的大脑区域会对此作出反应而被激活。

ex.s: All riders are equipped with reflective vests and safety lights.
ex.t: 所有骑行者都配备反光背心和安全灯。

ex.t: 游客参加节日灯光之旅需要做什么？

ex.s: Because of the way light reflects off the organisms，these phytoplankton create colourful patterns at the ocean surface.
ex.t: 由于光线从生物体上反射的方式，这些浮游植物在海洋表面形成了五彩斑斓的图案。

ex.s: The way light reflects off marine organisms.
ex.t: 光线从海洋生物上反射的方式。

ex.s: In southern Spain the sudden increase of greenhouses (which reflect light back to space) has changed the warming trend locally, and actually cooled the region.
ex.t: 在西班牙南部，温室（将光线反射回太空）的突然增加已经改变了当地的变暖趋势，实际上使该地区降温了。

ex.s: The light，about one-thousandth of the amount needed to read by，is just a start.
ex.t: 这种光约为阅读所需光强的千分之一，只是一个开端。

ex.s: Strano’s team found that they could create a faint light for three-and-a-half hours.
ex.t: 斯特拉诺的团队发现，他们能让植物发出微弱的光达三个半小时。

ex.s: “Herman is super positive and he's a bright light at our school who makes every child feel loved and heard. ”said Bakley.
ex.t: “赫尔曼特别积极，他是我们学校里的一束光，让每个孩子都感到被爱、被倾听。”巴克利说。

ex.s: Try your hand at some of the painting tricks used by artists whose works will be in the upcoming exhibition of American Watercolors 1880-1990: Into the Light.
ex.t: 亲手尝试一些画家的绘画技巧，他们的作品将出现在即将举办的“美国水彩1880-1990：走进光明”展览中。

ex.s: Once we found the place, it was stressful getting lights and cameras set up in the limited time.
ex.t: 一旦我们找到那个地方，在有限的时间里安装灯光和摄像头 压力很大。

ex.s: I would feel completely at ease doing my homework in bed, with light music on.

ex.t: 骑自行车是最经济、可持续且有趣的城市探索方式，这里有美丽的运河、公园、广场和无数的灯光。

defs.def: a thing that produces light, especially an electric light 发光体；光源；（尤指）电灯

ex.s: “I've seen those magic moments when children are talking to someone they are inspired by - their eyes are shining and their faces light up,” she said.
ex.t: “我曾见过那些神奇的时刻，当孩子们与激励他们的人交谈时——他们的眼睛闪闪发亮，脸上焕发光彩，”她说。

ex.s: Edison perfected an incandescent bulls that brought electric light into the American home.

defs.def: an expression in sb's eyes which shows what they are thinking or feeling 眼神

ex.s: That is why when the stars are out, they are visible, but when the lights are out, they are invisible.
ex.t: 这就是为什么当星星出来时，它们可以看到，但当灯熄灭时，它们就看不到了。

ex.s: For example, in English, "the stars are out" means "the stars can be seen in the sky", but "the lights are out" means "the lights are off".
ex.t: 例如，在英语中，the stars are out的意思是星星在天空中可以看到，但the lights are out的意思是灯熄灭了。

defs.def: light colours in a picture, which contrast with darker ones （图画中和暗色对比的）亮色，浅色

ex.s: I still have light skin and black hair, of course.
ex.t: 当然，我依然是白皙的皮肤和黑头发。

ex.s: These lights, known as adaptive signals, have led to significant declines in both the trouble and cost of travels between work and home.
ex.t: 这些被称为自适应信号的灯，使上下班通勤的麻烦和成本都显著下降。

defs.def: full of light; having the natural light of day 充满亮光的；明亮的；有自然光的

ex.t: 当灯光变成红色的时候，一辆车突然出现在拐角处。

of less than average or usual weight （比平均或平常重量）轻的
（与重量单位连用）分量不足的

ex.s: Mann said Terrafugia was helped by the Federal Aviation  Administration’s decision five years ago to create a separate set of standards for light sport aircraft, which are lower than those pilots of larger planes Terrafugia says an owner would need to pass a test and complete 20 hours of flying time to be able to fly the Transition, a requirement pilots would find relatively easy to meet.
ex.t: 曼说，Terrafugia得益于联邦航空管理局五年前做出的为轻型运动飞机制定一套单独标准的决定，这些标准低于大型飞机飞行员所需的标准。Terrafugia表示，车主需要通过一项测试并完成20小时的飞行时间才能驾驶Transition，飞行员会觉得这是很容易满足的要求。

defs.def: gentle or delicate; not using much force 轻柔的；柔和的；不太用力的
easy to do; not making you tired 容易做的；轻松的；不使人疲劳的

ex.s: She has had a light budget for her family.
ex.t: 她为家庭安排了宽松的预算。

ex.s: At the end of each session I return home feeling stronger, lighter, more able to carry on.
ex.t: 每次课程结束时，我回到家感觉更强壮、更轻松，更能继续下去。

ex.s: When we turn on a light or switch on a TV or a computer we use energy and we need water to produce this energy.
ex.t: 事实是我们很幸运无论何时想要都有干净的水，但这对于世界上许多人来说并非如此。

ex.s: When you struck the match to light your cigar I saw it was the face of the man wanted in Chicago.

ex.s: Hoping to impress some talented actors to come and work for me for nothing, I spread some throws over the sofas and lit candles to make it seem a bit more “young professional”.

ex.s: The technology, Strano said, could one day be used to light the rooms or even to turn tree into self-powered street lamps.

ex.s: A spotlight lights up only one section of a stage; similarly,"spotsound" creates a circle of sound in on targeted area.

defs.def: to guide sb with a light 用光指引

ex.s: Researchers use brain imaging technique to see which brain areas light up when we view paintings that we consider beautiful.
